text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, what a magnificent view!
The weather's great, and the breeze feels so nice♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, this reminds me of the park near my house~
I used to sing out towards the wide open scenery all the time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...
Maybe I should... go all out for the first time in a while?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah～～♪
These feelings bet upon the turf～♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that felt so refreshing~♪
I'd better head back to the academy soon...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously!?
Training time is already overーー!?
In the end, Kitasan Black ended up slacking off on her training...
